name: validate-deck
body: Validate deck: apply config, filename, template, section, field, body/Markdown, link and image rules uniformly at every level, in the fixed order: kalide.yaml → slide filenames (numbering, letters, label uniqueness) → each slide in number/letter order, top-to-bottom by line (frontmatter, body, sections, fields) → inter-slide #label links last (need all labels known). It is fail-fast by default — it stops at and returns the first validation error in that order — and it also runs in a collect-all mode that gathers every error, in the same order, for `kalide check --all` (cli-check). An image field's path is existence-checked against its declared roots — the deck's `assets/` by default, or a library layer's `media/` — and a path naming no file is reported with a closest-match suggestion (image-field-roots).
